claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Daphnetin is a coumarin antioxidant/anti-inflammatory with no potent cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect is weak and likely reflects nonspecific antioxidant/anti-inflammatory or mild iron-chelating activity rather than a kinase-inhibitory cytotoxic program.
